description:
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's second ability by tapping it, returning Crimson Kobolds to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crimson Kobolds enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
